terrainDescription.zh: 中美洲面積最小、人口密度最高的國家，境內火山鏈貫穿中部，僅臨太平洋、無加勒比海岸線，沿海有狹長農業平原。
terrainDescription.en: Central America's smallest and most densely populated country; a volcanic chain runs through the center, and it borders only the Pacific — no Caribbean coastline — with a narrow coastal agricultural plain.

plate.color: white/tan background, black text; current design features the national flag in the background

historicalContext.zh: 官方語言為西班牙語，境內原住民語言使用者比例在中美洲各國中相對最低；道路標誌採用中美洲共通的 MUTCD 式區域標準，距離以公里計算。
historicalContext.en: Spanish is official; indigenous-language speakers make up a comparatively small share of the population versus other Central American countries. Road signage follows the shared Central American MUTCD-derived regional standard, with distances in kilometers.
